name: John Mark
background: The teenage son of Mary, owner of the Upper Room. He is observant and later records the Gospel of Mark based on Peter's accounts.

genericReactions.physical: I saw that. I should write it down before I forget the detail.
genericReactions.testimonial: I am listening to what everyone says. Peter's account is the most vivid.
genericReactions.digital: I am trying to keep a record of these things. It feels important.
genericReactions.environmental: This happened in my mother's house. I will never forget the feeling in that room.
genericReactions.analytical: So many details to remember. I must get the sequence right.
genericReactions.prophecy: He spoke of the prophets. I need to go back and read them again.
